name: AAVAS Financiers Ltd
title: AAVAS Financiers Ltd - 541988 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Affordable housing NBFC with 15% AUM growth and FY26 disbursements up 11%; NIM and spread gains are real but management is guiding to 20%+ growth and sub-3% opex/AUM with no numeric FY27 targets reconciling to recent volume declines.

triggers.label: Q4 disbursements up 36% Q-o-Q
triggers.quote: We disbursed Rs. 23.5 billion, 16% higher than same time last year and 36% growth Q-o-Q
triggers.highlight: We disbursed Rs. 23.5 billion, 16% higher than same time last year and 36% growth Q-o-Q

triggers.label: Yields down 20 bps Q-o-Q on PLR cut
triggers.quote: we have come down 62 bps in overall cost of borrowing, and which is largely stabilizing at that level
triggers.highlight: cost of borrowing, and which is largely stabilizing at that level

triggers.label: Loan volumes flat, home loan volumes down YoY
triggers.quote: On a full year basis, the total number of loans disbursed are flat. And in home loans, in fact, you've declined on a Y-o-Y basis in terms of volume.
triggers.highlight: in home loans, in fact, you've declined on a Y-o-Y basis in terms of volume

guidance.value: below 25 bps on a sustainable basis
guidance.quote: We continue to maintain our guidance on keeping credit costs under check and below 25 bps on a sustainable basis.
We're very confident to maintain the spreads 5%+.

guidance.value: below 3% on a 2-3 year platform; 2.75% once balance sheet doubles
guidance.quote: I think on a 2-to-3-year platform, yes. We are shooting for something below 3%.
Our aspiration clearly is to consistently deliver 20% -plus AUM growth
high teens is where our eyes are very clearly set on ROE.

red_flags.label: Repeated evasion on growth shortfall and volume decline
red_flags.quote: Every human being, including me, becomes wiser in hindsight.

red_flags.label: Opex/AUM rose YoY on missed growth
red_flags.quote: This year, we had higher opex than last year.

evasions.topic: Growth shortfall over last two years
evasions.quote: Every human being, including me, becomes wiser in hindsight.
increase of yield by no manner suggests increase of risk.
